## 3. Grounding and Search Failures (Copilot Can't Find Files / "Can't reference your work data")

### 3a. Semantic Index: How It Works and Timelines

**Symptom:** Copilot says "I couldn't find anything" or fails to surface documents the user has access to.
**Cause:** The Semantic Index may not yet be built, or the content in question is not indexed.

**How it works:**
- The Semantic Index automatically runs for all M365 Copilot tenants (no admin action required to enable).
- Tenant-level index: Organization-wide, from text-based SharePoint Online files. SharePoint sites must be searchable (Search and offline availability = Yes).
- User-level index: Personalized index of the user's working data (emails, docs they interact with, comment on, or share). Emails indexed near real-time; new SharePoint docs accessible by 2+ users indexed daily; updates to indexed docs processed immediately.
- File size: Up to 512 MB for PDF, PPTX, DOCX.
- Cannot be disabled (no admin toggle). It can only be excluded at the SharePoint site level.

**Admin action to support indexing:**
- Ensure SharePoint sites are not excluded from search (Site Settings > Search and offline availability = Yes).
- Turning off People insights or Item insights in the Search and Intelligence portal reduces Copilot relevance.
- Oversharing sensitive data via "Everyone except external users" (EEEU) permission exposes it to Copilot. Disable EEEU at tenant level as part of Copilot deployment.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftsearch/semantic-index-for-copilot
Confidence: **High** (doc updated April 2026)

---

### 3b. SharePoint Site Excluded from Search

**Symptom:** Files in a specific SharePoint site never appear in Copilot results.
**Cause:** The site has been excluded from search by an admin (Site Settings > Search and offline availability = No).
**Fix:**
1. Browse to the site with admin permissions.
2. Settings > Site information > View all site settings > Search and offline availability.
3. Set "Allow this site to appear in search results" to Yes.
Note: This toggles both Microsoft Search and the Semantic Index together; you cannot exclude from one without the other.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftsearch/semantic-index-for-copilot
Confidence: **High**

---

### 3c. Permissions Gate

**Symptom:** Copilot can't find a document even though the user knows it exists.
**Cause:** Copilot strictly enforces existing M365 RBAC. It only returns content the currently signed-in user already has access to. If a file is not shared with the user or is in a restricted site, Copilot will not find it.
**Fix:** Verify the user has at least Read permissions on the SharePoint site/document library. Use SharePoint Advanced Management permission state reports to audit overly restrictive permissions.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftsearch/semantic-index-for-copilot
Source: https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/discussions/copilotforsmallandmediumbusiness/why-can%E2%80%99t-copilot-find-my-files-here%E2%80%99s-what-you-need-to-know/4487819
Confidence: **High**

---

### 3d. Content Not in OneDrive or SharePoint

**Symptom:** Files stored locally or in a non-M365 cloud service are not found by Copilot.
**Cause:** Copilot's grounding only covers content in Microsoft Graph: OneDrive, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online. Local files, network shares, and non-connected external sources are not in scope.
**Fix:** Move or sync relevant content to OneDrive/SharePoint. For external content, use a Graph Connector (see section 5).

Source: https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/discussions/copilotforsmallandmediumbusiness/why-can%E2%80%99t-copilot-find-my-files-here%E2%80%99s-what-you-need-to-know/4487819
Confidence: **High**

---

### 3e. Delegated, Shared, or Archive Mailboxes Not Indexed

**Symptom:** Copilot in Outlook cannot reference email from a shared or delegated mailbox.
**Cause:** By design, only the user's primary mailbox in Exchange Online is indexed. Delegated mailboxes, shared mailboxes, group mailboxes, and archived mailbox data are explicitly not supported in either the user-level or tenant-level index.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftsearch/semantic-index-for-copilot (supported content types table)
Confidence: **High**

---

### 3f. Recently Added Files Not Yet Indexed

**Symptom:** User uploaded a file minutes ago; Copilot can't find it.
**Cause:** SharePoint docs are indexed daily (not immediately) if accessible to 2+ users. Personal OneDrive changes are indexed faster but not instantly.
**Fix:** Wait and retry. For time-sensitive scenarios, users can paste the SharePoint URL directly into the Copilot prompt as a grounding reference; this bypasses the index and retrieves directly.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftsearch/semantic-index-for-copilot
Confidence: **High**

---

### 3g. PDF / Complex Format Indexing Issues

**Symptom:** PDFs or large complex files not surfaced correctly.
**Cause:** Large or complex PDFs had historically been problematic. Microsoft has expanded support to files up to 512 MB for PDF, PPTX, and DOCX. Community guidance previously recommended a maximum of ~36,000 characters (~15-20 pages) for reliability in agent knowledge bases.
**Fix:** For agent knowledge bases (Copilot Studio), keep source documents concise. For general Copilot, files up to 512 MB are now officially supported.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftsearch/semantic-index-for-copilot
Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/answers/questions/2168440/copilot-bad-indexing-pdfs-from-sharepoint
Confidence: **Medium** (agent-specific limit from community; 512 MB limit from official docs)

---

### 3h. SharePoint Column Metadata Not Used

**Symptom:** Copilot can find files but results are imprecise when the user queries against custom metadata columns.
**Cause:** Metadata-aware scoped queries only apply when the user attaches (or provides the URL of) a specific SharePoint library or folder, and only on the web experience. Prompts to list items based on custom metadata (e.g., "assigned to me" from a custom field) are not supported as a general known limitation.
**Fix:** Ensure the SharePoint site is searchable. Scope queries to specific libraries/folders. For custom metadata lookups in agents, use title/description matching instead (workaround per known-issues page).

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftsearch/semantic-index-for-copilot
Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/known-issues
Confidence: **High**

---

## 4. Latency and Performance

### 4a. Network Configuration

**Symptom:** Copilot responses are slow; "We can't reach Copilot" errors; timeouts.
**Cause:** Common network blockers:
- WebSocket (WSS) connections blocked at the perimeter. Copilot enterprise experiences require WSS to `*.cloud.microsoft` and `*.office.com`.
- TLS inspection breaking WSS connections.
- Proxy servers enforcing aggressive connection timeouts.
- Required M365 endpoints blocked.

**Fix:**
1. Allow all M365 worldwide URLs and IP ranges: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/urls-and-ip-address-ranges
2. Verify WSS is not blocked for `*.cloud.microsoft` and `*.office.com`.
3. Exempt M365 traffic from TLS inspection (especially for `*.cloud.microsoft`, `*.office.com`).
4. Use direct egress to Microsoft Global Network; minimize hairpinning through corporate proxies.
5. Microsoft is consolidating Copilot endpoints under `*.cloud.microsoft` to simplify network configuration going forward.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-requirements
Confidence: **High**

---

### 4b. Office Feature Updates Task and CDN Access

**Symptom:** Slow to load Copilot features; inconsistent feature availability.
**Cause:** Office Feature Updates task requires access to the Office CDN. If the task is blocked or fails, feature updates (including Copilot improvements) may not be applied.
**Fix:** Whitelist CDN access. If using Configuration Manager for updates, ensure the Delivery Optimization or direct CDN path for M365 Apps is not blocked.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-requirements
Confidence: **High**

---

### 4c. Mobile Requirements

For reference: iOS 16+ / iPadOS 16+ / Android 10+ are the minimum supported mobile OS versions. Older versions are not supported.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-minimum-requirements
Confidence: **High**

---

### 4d. Long Session Degradation

**Symptom:** Copilot starts responsive but slows significantly over a long conversation session.
**Cause:** Likely server-side session management; not a client issue. Confirmed pattern in community reports.
**Fix:** Start a new Copilot conversation. No persistent client-side fix; open a support ticket if reproducible and business-impacting.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/answers/questions/5443057/copilot-gets-slower-and-slower
Confidence: **Low** (community report; no official root cause published)

---

## 5. Plugin, Connector, and Agent Issues

### 5a. Graph Connector Agent (GCA) Offline / Not Running

**Symptom:** Connector in admin center shows offline; crawls not running.
**Cause:** GcaHostService is not running.
**Fix:**
1. Open Task Manager, confirm `GcaHostService` is in Running state. If not, open services.msc and start it.
2. Verify `gcs.office.com` is reachable (or `gcsgcc.office.com` for GCC, `gcs.office365.us` for GCC-High).
3. Use the Health Check feature in the Registration Details page of the connector (Microsoft 365 admin center) to run automated health checks.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/custom-connector-sdk-troubleshooting
Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/connectors/connector-agent
Confidence: **High**

---

### 5b. GCA Port Configuration Issues

**Symptom:** Crawls fail with "connector unavailable on specified port."
**Cause:** Port changed in connector code but port map configuration file not updated, or GcaHostService not restarted after config change.
**Fix:**
1. Verify connector is running on the specified port (not crashed).
2. Update port map configuration file with new values.
3. Restart GcaHostService via services.msc.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/custom-connector-sdk-troubleshooting
Confidence: **High**

---

### 5c. GCA Upgrade Connection Failures

**Symptom:** After upgrading GCA from version 1.8.0.0 or earlier, connections fail.
**Fix:**
1. Control Panel > Programs and Features > Graph Connector Agent > Repair.
2. Update the new port map file with previous configurations.
3. Resume any failed connections from Microsoft 365 admin center.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/custom-connector-sdk-troubleshooting
Confidence: **High**

---

### 5d. Items Missing from Connector Index

**Symptom:** Previously indexed items disappear from Copilot results.
**Cause:** Delete detection logic removes items missing from success responses. If >10% of items result in crawl failures, items not included in the last two crawls are deleted from the index.
**Fix:** Ensure crawl success rate stays above 90%. Check connector logs (default path: `C:\Users\{User}\AppData\Local\Microsoft\{ConnectorName}\Logs\ConnectorLog.log` or system paths for Windows Service installs). Investigate RPC errors on the gRPC status codes page.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/custom-connector-sdk-troubleshooting
Confidence: **High**

---

### 5e. SharePoint Grounding Fails Silently in Declarative Agents ("Sorry, I wasn't able to respond")

**Symptom:** Agent provisions successfully and is published, but returns "Sorry, I wasn't able to respond" at runtime when grounded on SharePoint.
**Cause:** Most common cause: the signed-in user does not have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. SharePoint/OneDrive knowledge sources require an active Copilot license. CDX demo tenant accounts without Copilot license will hit this silently.
**Secondary causes:** User does not have Read access to the SharePoint site in `items_by_url`; agent connection uses service principal (not supported for SharePoint grounding — must use User authentication).
**Fix:**
1. Ensure user has Copilot license (or use Microsoft 365 Copilot Developer License in dev tenants).
2. Verify user has at least Read permissions on the target SharePoint site.
3. Confirm agent connection uses User authentication, not service principal.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/known-issues
Confidence: **High**

---

### 5f. Power Automate Flows as Agent Actions Unreliable

**Symptom:** Agent actions using Power Automate Flows don't return results consistently; newly created flows may not appear in the Add Action interface.
**Cause:** Known product issue; Power Automate Flows are not fully supported as actions in declarative agents.
**Workaround:** No workaround for result reliability. For trigger success, edit the flow's description on the flow details page outside of Copilot Studio.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/known-issues
Confidence: **High** (listed as known issue in official docs, March 2026)

---

### 5g. Custom Metadata Queries Not Supported in Connectors / Agents

**Symptom:** Prompt "Get all tickets assigned to me" where "assigned to" is a custom metadata field returns no results.
**Cause:** Known limitation: prompts to get lists based on custom metadata are not supported. The metadata field must be mapped to connection schema label properties (title, description) to be queryable.
**Workaround:** None currently. Use title/description-based queries.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/known-issues
Confidence: **High**

---

### 5h. OpenAPI Plugin Limitations

Key unsupported features for API plugins:
- Nested objects in request bodies/parameters
- `oneOf`/`allOf`/`anyOf` and circular references (workaround: flatten the schema)
- API keys in custom headers, query params, or cookies
- OAuth flows other than Authcode and PKCE Authcode
- Dual auth flows for a single endpoint
- Multiple response semantics for a single function
- `OpenURL` and `ToggleVisibility` adaptive card actions in response semantics

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/known-issues
Confidence: **High**

---

### 5i. Custom Engine Agents: Scope Limitations

Custom engine agents built with M365 Agents Toolkit / SDK are not supported in Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or the Microsoft Edge browser (only Teams and Copilot Chat). Adaptive Cards using `Action.Execute` refreshes do not persist when the conversation is reopened.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/known-issues
Confidence: **High**

---

### 5j. Government Tenant Extensibility Gaps

Not supported in Microsoft 365 Government tenants:
- Authenticated custom actions
- Usage billing for extensibility features
- Publishing agents via Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/known-issues
Confidence: **High**

## 6. Diagnostic Tooling

### 6a. Copilot Service Plan Diagnostic

**Tool:** Run Tests: Copilot Service Plan Diagnostic
**Access:** Microsoft 365 admin center > Support > Help and Support > type "copilot missing", or go directly to https://aka.ms/PillarCopilotServicePlan
**Role required:** AI Administrator
**What it does:** Accepts a user UPN or email, lists every M365 Copilot service plan assigned to that user. Use this to identify missing service plans when specific Copilot features are absent.
**Known issue:** Tool and admin center can become unsynchronized for older accounts. Fix: uncheck affected service plan, save, re-enable, save, rerun.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-service-plans
Confidence: **High**

---

### 6b. Copilot License Details Diagnostic

**Tool:** Copilot License Details
**Access:** https://aka.ms/CopilotLicenseDetails
**What it does:** Verifies whether a specific user account meets all necessary requirements to access Copilot features.

Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-licensing
Confidence: **High**

---

### 6c. Microsoft 365 Service Health Dashboard

**Access:** M365 admin center > Health > Service health (or from the Home dashboard Health card). Requires at least Global Reader role.

# Microsoft 365 Copilot: Monitoring/Adoption, Limitations, and Learning Resources

---

## PART A — Monitoring, Adoption & Known Limitations

---

### 1. Microsoft Copilot Dashboard (powered by Viva Insights)

**What it shows:**
The Microsoft Copilot Dashboard in Viva Insights is the primary post-deployment analytics tool. It covers four pillars:
- **Readiness** — license deployment status, which users are ready for Copilot
- **Adoption** — total Copilot licensed employees vs. active users (users with at least one Copilot activity in the previous 28 days); adoption-by-group graph over 6 months (aggregated weekly); app-level breakdowns; retention trends
- **Impact** — estimated financial savings from Copilot activity; per-app impact metrics across Teams, Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.
- **Sentiment** — survey-based signals if configured

As of early 2026 there is also a separate **Agent Dashboard** (Public Preview Feb 2026, GA September 2026) showing adoption and usage of agents within Copilot. [Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/viva/insights/copilot-analytics-introduction]

**How to access:**
- Available in the Viva Insights web app at https://insights.viva.office.com
- Senior leaders (as determined by Entra ID org chart) have automatic access; managers must be enabled via Manager settings; delegation to others is supported
- Data becomes available within 7 days of license assignment; dashboard refreshes daily with up to 6-day data lag

**Licensing:**
- The Copilot Dashboard is available at no extra charge to any customer with at least one M365/O365 business or enterprise subscription with Exchange Online — even without Copilot licenses
- Since mid-March 2025, Viva Insights service plan is **included in the M365 Copilot license** — no separate Viva premium license required for the core dashboard
- For full advanced features (agent insights, benchmarks, intelligent summaries, group-level scoping, delegation, survey data): minimum of 50 combined Copilot + Viva Insights licenses required
- Agent Dashboard requires at least 50 M365 Copilot licenses and agent activity

[Sources: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/viva/insights/org-team-insights/copilot-dashboard | https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/viva_insights_blog/the-microsoft-copilot-dashboard-is-now-included-with-copilot-for-microsoft-365/4198372 | https://office365itpros.com/2025/05/19/microsoft-365-copilot-license-sp/]

---

### 2. Usage Reports in the M365 Admin Center + AI Adoption Score

**Copilot Usage Report (Admin Center):**
- Path: Admin Center → Reports → Usage → Microsoft 365 Copilot → Copilot tab
- Timeframes: 7, 30, 90, or 180 days
- Key metrics:
  - **Enabled Users** — total licensed users over the selected period
  - **Active Users** — users who performed an intentional Copilot action (submitting a prompt counts; just opening the pane does not)
  - **Active Users Rate** — active/enabled ratio
  - **Active Agent Users** — users interacting with org-built agents
  - **Total Prompts Submitted** and **Average Prompts Per User** (Copilot Chat only)
  - **Adoption by App** — per-app breakdown: Teams, Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, Loop, Edge, M365 app
  - **Agent Adoption** trend chart
  - Per-user **Last Activity Date** table (exportable to CSV)
- Report typically available within 72 hours of activity
- Word/Excel/PowerPoint data is incomplete before January 25, 2024

**Copilot Readiness Report:**
- Shows technical eligibility for Copilot licenses before deployment; identifies which users are ready and which are not based on prerequisite M365 service usage
- [Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/activity-reports/microsoft-365-copilot-readiness?view=o365-worldwide]

**AI Adoption Score:**
- A new score that measures how much licensed Copilot users have made Copilot a daily habit
- Score of 100 = all licensed users using Copilot features on average 3+ days/week (12 of the past 28 days)
- Allows benchmarking against peer organizations
- GA announced on the Microsoft 365 Blog
- [Sources: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/adoption/ai-adoption-score?view=o365-worldwide | https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/microsoft_365blog/announcing-general-availability-of-ai-adoption-score/4403118]

[Primary admin report source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/activity-reports/microsoft-365-copilot-usage?view=o365-worldwide]

---

### 3. Viva Insights Advanced Copilot Analytics

**Copilot Analytics encompasses five areas:**
1. Readiness & adoption report (Admin Center)
2. Microsoft Copilot Dashboard (Viva Insights web app)
3. Agent Dashboard (Viva Insights web app, early 2026)
4. Copilot Analytics Reports — out-of-the-box reports for leaders and analysts (no analyst role required)
5. Advanced Reporting — 100+ Copilot metrics, customizable filters, Power BI templates, business impact data upload

**Advanced Reporting Power BI templates:**
- Copilot Adoption Report
- Copilot Headlines Report
- Copilot Impact Report
- Copilot for Sales Adoption Report
- Copilot Business Impact Report (requires uploading business outcome data — e.g., deal size, ticket resolution rate)
- Copilot Studio Agents Report

**Setup:** Requires the **Insights Analyst** role in Viva Insights. Org data upload from Entra ID is automatic; additional attributes can be uploaded via CSV, API, or Azure Blob import.

[Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/viva/insights/copilot-analytics-introduction]

### 4. Known Limitations

#### Context Window and Document Limits
- In-app Copilot (Word, PowerPoint, etc.) uses retrieval pipelines that chunk documents; practical summarization limit ~300 pages or ~1.5M words; in-app rewriting limited to ~3,000 words
- Copilot Chat and agent contexts run on 64K–128K token windows depending on the model
- When a prompt references many documents, Copilot selects the ~20 most relevant files and ignores the rest
- File upload size for PDF, PPTX, DOCX: now supports up to **512 MB** per file
- [Sources: https://www.datastudios.org/post/microsoft-copilot-context-window-explained-token-limits-memory-behavior | https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftsearch/semantic-index-for-copilot]

#### Semantic Index Lag and Supported Content
- Semantic index is automatically enabled; no admin setup required and cannot be disabled
- New SharePoint content added by users is indexed in near real-time at the user level; new SharePoint Online site documents are indexed **daily** (not real-time) at the tenant level
- **NOT indexed**: Delegated mailboxes, shared mailboxes, archived mailbox data, archived SharePoint data
- **Indexed at user level**: personal mailbox, Word, PowerPoint, PDF, web pages (aspx), OneNote

- The official guidance is to always verify Copilot outputs, especially for factual claims

> This maps cleanly onto the **MS-102 / SC-400** exam objectives and the GRC + M365 admin roles you're targeting ([[project_clyde_accenture]], [[reference_job_search_claude_note]]). The "Security & Data Governance" section is the part that differentiates a GRC candidate from a generalist helpdesk admin.

#### 1. Licensing & Prerequisites
**The two add-on SKUs (both sit on top of a qualifying base license):**
- **Microsoft 365 Copilot** (enterprise) — **$30/user/month, paid yearly**. No minimum seat count (the original 300-seat floor was removed in Jan 2024). [Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/pricing/enterprise) · [Seat-minimum removal](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/blog/2024/01/15/expanding-copilot-for-microsoft-365-to-businesses-of-all-sizes/)
- **Microsoft 365 Copilot Business** (SMB, ≤300 seats) — promo **$18/user/mo**, standard **$21/user/mo**, annual commitment, 300-seat cap. [Copilot Business FAQ](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/copilot-business-faq)

**Qualifying base licenses** (you must already own one of these to attach the add-on): M365 E3/E5/F1/F3, Business Basic/Standard/Premium, Apps for Business/Enterprise; Office 365 E1/E3/E5/F3; Teams Essentials/Enterprise; Exchange Plan 1/2; SharePoint Plan 1/2; OneDrive Plan 1/2; Visio/Project plans; plus Education (A1/A3/A5) and Government (G3/G5/F1) SKUs. [Licensing requirements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-licensing)

**Hard technical prerequisites** ([Minimum requirements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-minimum-requirements) · [Requirements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-requirements)):
- **Identity:** Microsoft Entra ID account. Guests/cross-tenant users are **not** supported.
- **Mailbox:** primary mailbox on **Exchange Online**. On-prem/hybrid, archive, shared, group, and delegate mailboxes are **not** supported for grounding.
- **Apps:** Microsoft 365 Apps deployed with **user-based** licensing (device-based licensing is unsupported). "Connected experiences" privacy setting must be allowed.
- **Update channel:** **Current Channel** or **Monthly Enterprise Channel** only. **Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel does not get Copilot** — this is the single most common "why is it missing" cause. [Setup](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-setup)
- **Network:** allow [all M365 URLs/IP ranges](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/urls-and-ip-address-ranges); **WebSockets (WSS)** must reach `*.cloud.microsoft` and `*.office.com` (TLS inspection and aggressive proxy timeouts break this).
- **Browser:** modern browser with **third-party cookies enabled** (required for Word/Excel/PowerPoint on the web).

**Copilot Chat (free tier) vs. licensed Copilot:** Copilot Chat is included free with any eligible M365 plan and provides web-grounded chat **with Enterprise Data Protection** when signed in with an Entra account. It does **not** include work-data grounding via Microsoft Graph, in-app Copilot in Word/Excel/etc., or priority access. The $30 license adds Graph grounding, in-app Copilot, Teams meeting Copilot, agents at no extra metered cost, and priority access. [Licensing doc](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-licensing) · [Chat requirements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-chat-requirements)
> Naming trap: in Jan 2025 Microsoft reused the name "Microsoft 365 Copilot" for both the paid add-on **and** the renamed M365 app, and rebranded "Bing Chat Enterprise" → "Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat." [Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/overview)

#### 2. Deployment & Rollout
Microsoft's recommended sequence ([Enablement resources](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-enablement-resources) · [Rollout](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-minimum-requirements-rollout)):
1. **Readiness/assessment** — run the [Copilot Optimization Assessment](https://www.microsoft.com/solutionassessments/) and clean up oversharing with SharePoint Advanced Management *before* go-live (see §4).
2. **Pick license**, set update channels, validate network/privacy.
3. **Assign licenses** — Admin center → Billing → Licenses → Microsoft 365 Copilot (individual or group-based). Shows in apps within ~24h. The [Copilot Setup guide](https://admin.microsoft.com/Adminportal/Home?Q=learndocs#/modernonboarding/microsoft365copilotsetupguide) walks it.
4. **Phased pilot → deploy → operate.** Use the **Readiness Report** to find your best pilot candidates (it flags the top 25% of unlicensed users by M365 usage intensity). [Readiness report](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/activity-reports/microsoft-365-copilot-readiness)
5. **Train users** — [Copilot Success Kit](https://adoption.microsoft.com/copilot/success-kit/), [Prompt Gallery](https://copilot.cloud.microsoft/prompts).
6. **Monitor** with the Copilot Dashboard (see §6).

**Admin roles:** use the least-privilege **AI Administrator** Entra role for day-to-day Copilot management rather than Global Admin; **Global Reader** for read-only. [Copilot page/roles](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-page)
**Per-user validation tool:** [aka.ms/CopilotLicenseDetails](https://aka.ms/CopilotLicenseDetails) confirms a specific account meets every requirement.

#### 3. Admin Controls — The Copilot Control System (CCS)
There is **no separate "Copilot admin center" URL** — the CCS is the **Copilot node inside admin.microsoft.com**. [Management controls](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/microsoft-365/copilot-control-system/management-controls) · [Copilot settings page](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-page)

**admin.microsoft.com → Copilot → Settings** has four tabs:
| Tab | Key controls |
|---|---|
| **User access** | Copilot Frontier program, pay-as-you-go billing, pin Copilot Chat, pin app to taskbar, self-service purchase, Edge config |
| **Data access** | Agent access policy, web search policy (links to Cloud Policy), other-LLM (Anthropic) providers, Purview shortcuts |
| **Copilot actions** | Image generation toggle, Teams-meeting Copilot (links to Teams admin center) |
| **Other settings** | Custom dictionary, **Copilot diagnostics logs** |

**Managing Copilot Chat:** Enterprise Data Protection auto-applies on Entra sign-in (not a toggle). The **"Allow web search in Copilot"** policy lives in Cloud Policy (config.office.com) and governs both Chat and licensed Copilot; web search is **on by default commercially but off by default in GCC/DoD**. [Manage Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/manage)
**The Copilot app** is governed as an Integrated App (admin.microsoft.com → Apps → Integrated apps); blocking it there is a tenant-wide block across the app, Outlook, Teams, and web.

#### 3b. Agent Management
Five agent categories (org-published, creator-shared, Microsoft, partner, Frontier). Managed in two places: **CCS → Settings → Data access → Agents** (tenant-wide access policy) and **CCS → Agents → All agents** (the Agent Registry — full inventory, publish/block/approve, Requests tab). Copilot Studio agents also carry DLP/sharing controls in the **Power Platform admin center**. [Agents admin guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/agent-essentials/m365-agents-admin-guide) · [Manage agents/Integrated Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/manage/manage-copilot-agents-integrated-apps)

**Approval workflow:** maker publishes in Copilot Studio → agent lands in the **Requests tab** → admin reviews capabilities/data sources/security → **Publish or Reject** → appears in the org's Agent Store.

**Metered / pay-as-you-go billing:** agents that touch **tenant data** (SharePoint, Graph connectors) require metered billing and are **off by default** in Copilot Chat. Create a billing policy → link an **Azure subscription** → connect it to the service → set budget caps. Licensed Copilot users get tenant-data agents included. [PAYG overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/pay-as-you-go/overview)

#### 3c. Identity / Entra & RBAC
- **AI Administrator** — real Entra built-in role; least-privilege way to configure all of CCS. Recommended for daily admin. Microsoft recommends wrapping it (and Search Administrator) in **PIM** for just-in-time activation + MFA. [Agent prerequisites](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/microsoft-365/agent-essentials/agent-prerequisites)
- **Global Admin** — over-privileged; reserve for emergencies and connector consent.
- Graph-connector permissions (`ExternalItem.*`, `ExternalConnection.*`) normally need Global Admin consent but can be **delegated to AI Admin** via a Microsoft PowerShell script. [Connector admin delegation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/connector-admin-delegation)
- No Copilot-specific Conditional Access templates exist; standard Entra CA policies apply to Copilot like any other M365 app. To block personal-MSA sign-in, use **Tenant Restrictions v2**. [Manage Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/manage)

#### 3d. The Semantic Index for Copilot
A **vectorized index** layered on top of Microsoft Graph's lexical index so Copilot understands meaning/intent, not just keywords. It is **generated automatically once at least one Copilot license is assigned** — there is no enable toggle and **it cannot be disabled** (only excluded per-site). [Semantic Index doc](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftsearch/semantic-index-for-copilot)
- **Two levels:** *tenant-level* (text-based SharePoint files accessible to 2+ users) and *user-level* (personal mailbox + docs you authored/commented/were mentioned in). Both **fully respect existing RBAC** — the index never changes permissions.
- **Indexing cadence:** mailbox = near real-time; new shared SharePoint docs = **daily**; edits to already-indexed content = immediate.
- **Supported types:** Word, PowerPoint, PDF, .aspx, OneNote, mailbox, connector data. Files up to **512 MB**. **.xlsx is notably absent** from the supported list. Shared/delegated/archive mailboxes are **not** indexed.
- **Exclude a site:** Site settings → Search & offline availability → "No" (removes it from Microsoft Search **and** the semantic index together — you can't split them).

#### 4. Security & Data Governance (the GRC core)
**Data protection model** ([Privacy/security](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-privacy) · [Enterprise Data Protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/enterprise-data-protection)):
- **Prompts, responses, and Graph data are NOT used to train foundation models.** Stated explicitly and repeatedly by Microsoft.
- Copilot only surfaces content a user **already has at least view access to**; the semantic index honors the identity-based access boundary; data stays in the **M365 service boundary** and is processed by **Azure OpenAI** (not public OpenAI), which doesn't cache it.
- **EDP** = the DPA/Product-Terms commitments (encryption at rest/in transit, tenant isolation, GDPR, EU Data Boundary, ISO 27018, label inheritance, audit). Same contractual terms as Exchange/SharePoint.
- For **encrypted content**, the user needs **EXTRACT + VIEW** usage rights; S/MIME mail is never returned; Customer Key (BYOK) content is supported.
- **Caveat for residency:** newly disclosed **Anthropic models** used in Copilot are **out of scope for the EU Data Boundary**; Bing **web search** queries run under the Services Agreement, **not** the DPA (matters for HIPAA).

**Microsoft Purview for Copilot** ([Purview + Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/ai-m365-copilot)):
- **Sensitivity labels:** Copilot honors label encryption and **inherits the highest-priority label** when generating new content in Word/PowerPoint/Outlook. Labels must be **enabled for SharePoint/OneDrive** for encrypted files to be reachable beyond open desktop files. User-defined label permissions can block Copilot extraction entirely.
- **DLP for Copilot** (the "Microsoft 365 Copilot" DLP location) has three modes ([DLP location doc](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/dlp-microsoft365-copilot-location-learn-about)): (1) **prevent Copilot from processing label-protected files** (GA), (2) **block the response when a prompt contains a sensitive info type** (preview), (3) **block external web search when a prompt contains an SIT** (preview). Policy changes take up to 4h; can't mix label + SIT conditions in one rule; can't scan files uploaded into prompts.
- **Audit / eDiscovery / retention / Communication Compliance / Insider Risk** all cover Copilot interactions (stored in the user's mailbox). eDiscovery: search `Type → Copilot activity`. Retention location: `Microsoft Copilot Experiences`. IRM has a **"Risky AI usage"** template that detects prompt-injection.
- **DSPM for AI** is the "front door": auto-runs a **weekly risk assessment on the top 100 SharePoint sites**, offers one-click policies, and per-site/per-item remediation. (Note: the "classic" DSPM for AI is being replaced by the new DSPM experience.) [DSPM for AI](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/dspm-for-ai)

**Oversharing remediation — SharePoint Advanced Management (SAM)** ([Get ready for Copilot with SAM](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/get-ready-copilot-sharepoint-advanced-management)): Copilot doesn't create oversharing — it *exposes* it at AI speed. SAM's blueprint: run the **Content Management Assessment**, apply **site lifecycle/archiving**, run **Data Access Governance reports** (the EEEU "Everyone Except External Users" report is the key one), apply **Restricted Access Control**, and apply **Restricted Content Discovery** to high-risk sites.
- **Restricted Content Discovery (RCD)** — per-site denylist; stops a site appearing in org-wide search + Copilot **without changing permissions**. Needs SAM + ≥1 Copilot license. Scalable, delegable. [RCD](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/restricted-content-discovery)
- **Restricted SharePoint Search (RSS)** — tenant-wide **allowlist of ≤100 sites**, off by default, explicitly a **temporary stopgap** while you audit permissions. **Not a security boundary** — recently accessed / directly shared sites still surface. Disable it once governance is in place. [RSS](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/restricted-sharepoint-search)

#### 5. Troubleshooting (symptom → cause → fix)
**Copilot button/app missing:**
- **On Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel** → move to Current or Monthly Enterprise Channel. [Channel requirement](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/use-current-channel-or-the-monthly-enterprise-channel-to-access-copilot-features) · [Change channel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-apps/updates/change-channel-for-copilot)
- **License just assigned** → File → Account → Update License, restart apps; allow up to **24h** to propagate. [Missing/disabled Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/microsoft-365-apps/copilot/copilot-missing-disabled-not-work-correctly)
- **Device-based licensing** → convert to **user-based** (Copilot requires it).
- **"Connected experiences" disabled** (policy or File → Account → Account Privacy) → enable; on web, enable third-party cookies. [Find/enable Copilot button](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/how-to-find-and-enable-missing-copilot-button-in-microsoft-365-apps-c8482b93-4b96-4bb8-8ec9-5148f4d42441)
- **Dual personal+work sign-in** → make the licensed work account primary.

**License assignment problems:**
- Add-on **requires a qualifying base license** first (§1).
- **Service plan disabled** under the license → Admin center → user → Licenses and apps → expand Copilot → enable the needed [service plans](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-service-plans) (Productivity Apps, Teams, Graph-grounded chat, SharePoint, Graph Connectors, etc.). Known sync bug: uncheck → save → re-check → save → rerun the diagnostic.
- **Group-based licensing delays** → directly assign to the user, sign out/in; reconcile with the group after. [License validation errors](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/i-am-getting-license-validation-errors-with-copilot-375cf342-8559-48c3-8436-7564d5de3fc6)
- **Guest / non-Exchange-Online mailbox** → unsupported; migrate mailbox to Exchange Online.

**Grounding / "can't find my files":** ([Semantic Index](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftsearch/semantic-index-for-copilot) · [Why can't Copilot find my files](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/discussions/copilotforsmallandmediumbusiness/why-can%E2%80%99t-copilot-find-my-files-here%E2%80%99s-what-you-need-to-know/4487819))
- Site excluded from search (Search & offline availability = No) → set to Yes.
- Permissions gate — Copilot only returns what the user can already open; audit with SAM permission reports.
- Content not in OneDrive/SharePoint/Exchange → move it in or use a Graph connector.
- Recently added file not yet indexed (SharePoint = daily) → wait, or paste the file URL into the prompt to bypass the index.

**Latency / "can't reach Copilot":** almost always **network** — WSS blocked, TLS inspection breaking WSS, or proxy timeouts. Allow M365 endpoints, exempt `*.cloud.microsoft`/`*.office.com` from inspection, prefer direct egress. [Requirements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-requirements)

**Plugin / connector / agent issues:** ([Connector troubleshooting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/custom-connector-sdk-troubleshooting) · [Known issues](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/known-issues))
- Graph Connector Agent offline → confirm `GcaHostService` running, `gcs.office.com` reachable, run the Health Check on the Registration Details page.
- Connector items vanishing → keep crawl success **>90%** (delete-detection prunes items when >10% fail).
- Declarative agent returns **"Sorry, I wasn't able to respond"** on SharePoint grounding → the signed-in user **lacks a Copilot license** (most common), lacks Read on the site, or the agent uses a service principal instead of **User** auth.

**Diagnostic tooling:**
- [Copilot Service Plan Diagnostic](https://aka.ms/PillarCopilotServicePlan) (needs AI Admin) and [Copilot License Details](https://aka.ms/CopilotLicenseDetails).
- [Service health dashboard](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/view-service-health) for Copilot incidents; **Copilot diagnostics logs** in CCS → Other settings to submit logs for a user.
- **SaRA is deprecated** (removed from in-support Windows 2026-03-10); use the **"Get Help"** command-line tool instead. [SaRA removal](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/topic/microsoft-support-and-recovery-assistant-sara-command-line-utility-removal-from-windows-5913939c-87ff-45b0-8e9b-14dc89bfdfee)

#### 6. Monitoring & Adoption
- **Copilot Usage Report** (Admin center → Reports → Usage → Microsoft 365 Copilot): enabled vs. **active users** (an active user submitted a prompt — opening the pane doesn't count), per-app adoption, agent adoption, exportable per-user last-activity. ~72h lag. [Usage report](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/activity-reports/microsoft-365-copilot-usage)
- **AI Adoption Score** — 100 = all licensed users using Copilot 3+ days/week; benchmarks against peers. [AI Adoption Score](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/adoption/ai-adoption-score)
- **Microsoft Copilot Dashboard (Viva Insights)** — Readiness / Adoption / Impact / Sentiment, plus an **Agent Dashboard** (GA Sep 2026). **Included with the Copilot license** since mid-2025; full advanced features need ≥50 combined Copilot+Viva licenses. [insights.viva.office.com](https://insights.viva.office.com) · [Copilot Dashboard](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/viva/insights/org-team-insights/copilot-dashboard) · [Copilot Analytics intro](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/viva/insights/copilot-analytics-introduction)
- **Advanced Reporting** — 100+ metrics with Power BI templates (Adoption, Impact, Business Impact); needs the **Insights Analyst** role.

#### 7. Known Limitations
- **Context/size:** practical in-app summarization ~300 pages; rewrite ~3,000 words; Chat/agents on 64K–128K token windows; when many docs are referenced Copilot picks ~20 most relevant. File upload up to 512 MB.
- **Semantic index lag & gaps:** SharePoint tenant-level indexed **daily**; **.xlsx, shared/delegated/archive mailboxes not indexed**; can't be disabled.
- **Accuracy:** generative AI hallucinates (~3–10% depending on task); always verify factual output. [MS on AI accuracy](https://news.microsoft.com/source/features/ai/why-ai-sometimes-gets-it-wrong-and-big-strides-to-address-it/)
- **Government clouds:** significant feature gaps in **GCC/GCC-High/DoD** — web grounding off by default, no built-in Researcher/Analyst agents, no Teams Meeting Copilot, many app features unavailable; full GA reached GCC/GCC-High Dec 2025, DoD still rolling. [GCC feature availability](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office365/servicedescriptions/office-365-platform-service-description/microsoft-365-copilot#feature-availability)
- **No published latency SLA.**

- Hubs: [M365 Copilot admin hub](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/microsoft-365/) · [Adoption Hub](https://adoption.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/) · [Success Kit](https://adoption.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/success-kit/) · [Skilling Center](https://enablement.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/skilling-center/) · [Scenario Library](https://adoption.microsoft.com/copilot-scenario-library) · [Release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/release-notes)

Dedicated [M365 Copilot Mechanics playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXtHYVsvn_b8MTl8mD8FBJIB_cSGkEaT9) (also at [aka.ms/M365CopilotMechanics](https://aka.ms/M365CopilotMechanics)). Start with the "How Copilot for M365 Works" explainer in that playlist.

**YouTube — reputable independent MVPs (verified channels):**

All eight claims verified. Here are the results:

---

**1. Microsoft 365 Copilot enterprise add-on is $30/user/month.**
VERIFIED. Microsoft's own pricing page confirms $30.00 user/month, paid yearly.

---

**2. The 300-seat minimum was removed in January 2024.**
VERIFIED. Microsoft announced the removal on January 15, 2024, opening Copilot to businesses of any size.

---

**3. Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel does NOT receive Copilot features.**
VERIFIED. Microsoft's support docs confirm Copilot features are only available on Current Channel and Monthly Enterprise Channel, not Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel. (Note: Microsoft announced SAEC will begin receiving monthly feature updates starting July 2026, but Copilot availability on that channel has not been confirmed as a consequence.)

---

**4. Prompts/responses and Microsoft Graph data are NOT used to train foundation LLMs.**
VERIFIED. Microsoft's privacy documentation states explicitly: "Prompts, responses, and data accessed through Microsoft Graph aren't used to train foundation LLMs, including those used by Microsoft 365 Copilot."

---

**5. "AI Administrator" is a real Microsoft Entra built-in role for Copilot administration.**
VERIFIED. The AI Administrator role is a real Microsoft Entra built-in role, announced at Ignite 2025, scoped to manage Microsoft 365 Copilot, agents, and related AI services with least-privilege access.

---

## The things that actually trip admins up

**The #1 "why is Copilot missing" cause is the update channel.** Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel does *not* get Copilot. Only **Current Channel** or **Monthly Enterprise Channel**. [Channel requirement](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/use-current-channel-or-the-monthly-enterprise-channel-to-access-copilot-features)

**Licensing is an add-on on top of a qualifying base** (E3/E5, Business Standard/Premium, etc.). $30/user/mo enterprise (no seat minimum since Jan 2024), or $18–21 for Copilot Business under 300 seats. Mailbox must be **Exchange Online**; guests and device-based licensing are unsupported. [Licensing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-licensing)

**There's no separate "Copilot admin center"** — it's the Copilot node inside admin.microsoft.com (the **Copilot Control System**). Use the **AI Administrator** Entra role (a real built-in role) instead of Global Admin for day-to-day work. [Copilot settings](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-page)

## The GRC differentiator (your angle)

The part that separates a GRC candidate from a helpdesk admin is **oversharing remediation before go-live**. Copilot doesn't create oversharing, it *exposes* it at AI speed. The toolkit:
- **Purview**: sensitivity-label inheritance, DLP-for-Copilot (block label-protected files from processing), audit/eDiscovery on interactions, and **DSPM for AI** which auto-scans your top 100 SharePoint sites weekly. [Purview + Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/ai-m365-copilot)
- **SharePoint Advanced Management**: Data Access Governance reports (the EEEU report especially), plus **Restricted Content Discovery** (per-site, scalable) vs. **Restricted SharePoint Search** (tenant-wide ≤100-site allowlist that Microsoft explicitly calls a temporary stopgap and *not a security boundary*). [SAM blueprint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/get-ready-copilot-sharepoint-advanced-management)
- Confirmed: **prompts/responses and Graph data are not used to train foundation models**. [Privacy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-privacy)

## Troubleshooting cheat sheet
- **Button missing** → wrong channel / 24h license propagation / device-based licensing / "connected experiences" disabled.
- **"Can't find my files"** → site excluded from search, permissions gate, or not-yet-indexed (SharePoint indexes daily; paste the URL to bypass).
- **"Can't reach Copilot" / slow** → almost always WSS blocked or TLS inspection breaking `*.cloud.microsoft`.
- **Agent says "Sorry, I wasn't able to respond"** → signed-in user has no Copilot license (most common).
- **Note:** SaRA is dead as of March 2026; use the **Get Help** tool now.

text: If I encounter a new issue not covered by this cheat sheet, what are common things to try first as determined by simplicity and impact?

blocks.text:
Good instinct. Most novel Copilot issues collapse into a handful of root causes, and you can rule out the cheap, high-probability ones fast. Here's the order I'd actually work, lowest-effort-highest-yield first.

## Tier 1: 30-second checks (do these before anything else)

1. **Is it just you, or everyone?** Reproduce with a second licensed account / different machine. This single split tells you whether you're chasing an *identity/license* problem (one user) or a *tenant/service* problem (everyone). It's the highest-information move you can make and costs nothing.

2. **Check [service health](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/view-service-health).** Admin center → Health → Service health, filter for Copilot. Half the "it broke today and nothing changed" tickets are a Microsoft-side incident. Don't burn an hour before ruling this out.

3. **Sign out / restart the app / update license.** File → Account → Update License, then fully restart. Stale token and propagation lag (up to 24h) explain a huge share of "license is assigned but it's not working."

## Tier 2: the four root-cause buckets

Almost every Copilot problem lives in one of these. Walk them in this order because that's roughly worst-offender-first:

4. **Eligibility** — right [channel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-apps/updates/change-channel-for-copilot) (Current/Monthly Enterprise, never Semi-Annual), user-based (not device) licensing, Exchange Online mailbox, and the specific [service plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-service-plans) enabled under the license. Run the two diagnostics: [Copilot License Details](https://aka.ms/CopilotLicenseDetails) and the [Service Plan Diagnostic](https://aka.ms/PillarCopilotServicePlan).

5. **Permissions** — Copilot can only ever surface what the user can already open. If it "can't find" something, verify the user actually has access and the SharePoint site is searchable. This is the bucket people forget because it's not an "error," it's silent.

6. **Network/policy** — WSS to `*.cloud.microsoft` and `*.office.com`, TLS-inspection exemptions, third-party cookies on web, and the "connected experiences" privacy setting. These produce flaky, slow, or grayed-out behavior rather than clean errors.

7. **Indexing/freshness** — if it's about a specific recent document, the semantic index just may not have caught up (SharePoint = daily). Paste the file URL into the prompt to bypass the index and confirm.

## Tier 3: the meta-moves

8. **"What changed?"** New issue almost always = a recent change. Check the [Message Center](https://mc.merill.net/) and your own change log (a policy push, a channel switch, an Intune/Conditional Access tweak, a Purview DLP rule). Copilot is downstream of a lot of plumbing, so the cause is often something you changed elsewhere.

9. **Isolate the layer.** Does it fail in Copilot Chat on the web *and* in-app? Web-only failure points at browser/cookies; in-app-only points at the Office client/channel; everywhere points at license or service. Narrowing the surface narrows the cause.

10. **Reproduce with a clean variable** — new chat session (kills context/long-session degradation), incognito window (kills cache/extensions/cookies), known-good account on the affected machine (machine vs. identity).

The throughline: **prove whether it's identity, permissions, network, or service before you go deep on any one of them.** Steps 1–3 plus "what changed" resolve or correctly route the large majority of novel cases in a few minutes.
